name: steam-build
description: Æther NW.js desktop shell - Steam build tooling

scripts.prestart: node ensure-sdk.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs win && npm install --prefix app && node strip-parent-link.mjs
scripts.dist:win: node ensure-app-deps.mjs && node strip-parent-link.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs win && node build.mjs win && node postbuild-trim.mjs win && node verify-shipped-steam.mjs win
scripts.dist:linux: node ensure-app-deps.mjs && node strip-parent-link.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs linux && node build.mjs linux && node postbuild-trim.mjs linux && node verify-shipped-steam.mjs linux
scripts.dist:linux-arm64: node ensure-app-deps.mjs && node strip-parent-link.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs linux-arm64 && node build.mjs linux-arm64 && node postbuild-trim.mjs linux-arm64 && node verify-shipped-steam.mjs linux-arm64
scripts.dist:osx: node ensure-app-deps.mjs && node strip-parent-link.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs osx && node build.mjs osx && node postbuild-trim.mjs osx && node verify-shipped-steam.mjs osx
scripts.zip:win: npm run dist:win && node zip-dist.mjs win
scripts.zip:linux: npm run dist:linux && node zip-dist.mjs linux
scripts.zip:linux-arm64: npm run dist:linux-arm64 && node zip-dist.mjs linux-arm64
scripts.zip:osx: npm run dist:osx && node zip-dist.mjs osx
